card.line: Bithynia was a Roman province in Asia Minor where the Spirit stopped Paul from entering, and where Peter later wrote to scattered Christians living there.

moments.title: The Spirit says no
moments.text: Paul and his team came to the border of Mysia and tried to enter Bithynia. The Spirit of Jesus would not permit them, so they went down to Troas instead.

moments.title: Peter writes to believers
moments.text: Peter addressed his letter to God's chosen people scattered across several regions, and Bithynia was one of them. He reminded them of their living hope and told them their tested faith is more precious than gold.
